title: Neko hero
description: A window-filling media hero with one big soft-serif headline and a charcoal call-to-action at the foot. On desktop it pins for three-quarters of a screen while the full-bleed first picture shrinks into a card inset from the edges with a deep rounded bottom, a second picture fades in and the headline rises into place. On phones it is a plain full-screen picture with the headline centred.
notes: two media slots (first screen, then the one the card settles on); empty they are plain token surfaces
the headline is foreground-coloured: pick light, airy media (or a dark theme with dark media)
CSS scroll-driven, from 1024px; without support or with reduced motion it shows the settled card
